content.comment_body: Hello! I am working on a project and I want to prevent parameter changes while my program is running. I tried using a password, but it only restricts changes when the system is stopped. In RUN mode, no password is required.
Hi, If you enable the "Protection Active" setting in the block properties, you should be able to prevent parameter changes during RUN mode. Please see the attached file. Best regards, [user_name]
Could you clarify what you mean exactly? Are you referring to displaying block parameters in the message texts?

Hi, here is how you can protect parameters from being changed: 1. For message texts only: Open the message text properties and activate "Protection Active". 2. For parameter changes via operator device or basic module: Open the function block properties that you wish to secure and activate "Protection Active". If you only follow step 1, parameter changes via parameter mode remain possible. If you only follow step 2, changes through message texts are still possible. Based on your requirements, you may need to use both protections. Hope this is helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: The main challenge is preventing unauthorized or unintended parameter changes during operation. The default password protection restricts changes only when the system is stopped. Contributors highlight the need for more comprehensive parameter security and clarify that certain protection options in block properties may be overlooked by users, leading to confusion over where and how protections apply, which affects perceived system control and security.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the product to provide a reliable way to block or restrict parameter changes even in RUN mode, offering complete protection without requiring manual solutions.
